title: Start using search ads, display ads, online video and more | Microsoft Advertising

facts.fact: Microsoft Advertising offers new US customers a $500 ad credit when they spend $250 on advertising charges excluding taxes.
facts.quote: Get **$500** ad credit when you spend **$250** in Microsoft Advertising.

facts.fact: The Microsoft Advertising $500 promotional offer expires June 30, 2027.
Promotional credit not used within ninety days of award expires and cannot be carried over.
facts.quote: Any portion of the credit not used within ninety (90) days of credit award will expire and cannot be carried over or restored even if the Microsoft Advertising customer switches their payment method.

facts.fact: Microsoft Advertising says its network reaches more than 1 billion people across 187 markets globally.
facts.quote: Reach more than 1B people across 187 markets globally

facts.fact: Microsoft Advertising states its audiences are 51% more likely to be higher income, per comScore qSearch data from March 2026.
facts.quote: Tap into audiences that are 51% more likely to be higher income and 25% more likely to add to cart*.

facts.fact: Microsoft Advertising claims 19% lower CPCs compared to a leading ad platform, per EMARKETER KPI Forecast Q1 2026 (vendor-cited).
facts.quote: Get 19% lower CPCs and 6% higher CTRs**

facts.fact: Users spend over 4 hours daily across Microsoft experiences where Microsoft Advertising appears, per GWI data (Q4 2023 to Q3 2024).
facts.quote: With Microsoft Advertising, you can connect with **more than 1B** people where they spend over **4 hours a day**

facts.fact: The IKEA case study reports a 140% ROAS increase and 215% conversion increase through automated optimizations.
facts.quote: IKEA increased ROAS 140% and conversions 215% through automated optimizations

facts.fact: Microsoft Advertising offers a sign-up with no credit card required.
facts.quote: No credit card required. Get started in two minutes or log in with your Google account directly.
